Form CT4 (ITA 2010)
HM Government of Gibraltar
CLAIM TO REDUCE PAYMENTS ON ACCOUNT FOR AN ACCOUNTING PERIOD
Important notes & guidelines
WHEN SHOULD YOU USE THIS FORM?

This form is to be used to make a claim to the Commissioner of Income Tax to reduce the payments on account towards your corporation tax liability due on 30 September and 28 February, in accordance with section 39(5) of the Income Tax Act 2010 ("the Act").
WHAT IS THE DEADLINE FOR MAKING YOUR CLAIM?
This claim should be submitted before the payment on account of either 28 February and 30 September is due.
INSTANCES FOR MAKING A CLAIM?
You should make this claim if you believe that your tax liability for this accounting period is less than your tax liability for the last accounting period. This could be because:
you expect your trading profits to be lower; or
you expect other significant sources of income to be lower; or
more of your income will be taxed at source; or
more of your income will come from non-chargeable sources (e.g. interest and dividends).
HOW TO COMPLETE AND SUBMIT THE FORM?
Tick and complete the appropriate box(es) overleaf;
Make a reasonable estimate, on the basis of the information available now, of your expected corporation tax liability for the accounting period;
Enter half of this estimated amount in the reduced payment on account box overleaf. This is the amount of each of the two payments on account.
Please read, sign and date the declaration.
The completed form should be posted to the Income Tax Office at St. Jago's Stone Block, 331 Main Street, Gibraltar.
If you require any assistance in completing this form please contact this Office on Tel. No. 20074889.
WARNING
IF YOU PAY LESS THAN YOU SHOULD YOU WILL BE LIABLE TO A SURCHARGE IN ACCORDANCE WITH THE PROVISIONS OF SECTION 64 OF THE ACT
